text:
Mia: Heads up — opened PR to bump terraform-module/gpu-pools from v1.3.2 -> v1.4.0. Includes KMS key rotation support and stricter IAM roles. https://git.example.com/redwood/infra/merge_requests/512
Oliver: Nice. Any breaking changes to existing VPCs? :thinking_face:
Mia: No breaking changes to networking. We added optional kms_key_id param and tightened iam policy for node role. Default behavior unchanged.
Raj: Can we see the diff for the iam policy? worried about ecs/service-account perms.
Mia: Diff snippet:
```
- "Action": "s3:*",
+ "Action": ["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-artifacts/*"
```
Oliver: Good. That narrows scope.
devops-ci: CI pipeline started for MR !512 — tf fmt, validate, plan. Plan job ID: pipeline/9876
devops-ci: terraform plan produced 3 changes: +gpu_pool(2), ~kms_key rotation, -unused_iam_policy_attachment
Emily: Can we gate the rollout behind canary? We don't want mass provisioning in us-west-2 until we've validated.
Sasha: Recommend GitOps step: bump module version in live/overlays/us-west-2 only, let flux reconcile, watch metrics for 2 hours, then promote.
Raj: Also add a tfvar flag to disable kms rotation per env in case KMS quotas hit. ops have run into that before.
Mia: Added var: enable_kms_rotation = true by default. I'll add override in live/staging to false.
Oliver: How about drift detection? We've seen node config drift after auto-scaling scripts.
Sasha: We run drift-checker cron that compares tfstate with api. If drift > threshold we create an incident. We should add gpu_pool resource tagging to make detection reliable.
Mia: Added tags: { "service":"gpu-inference", "env":"${var.env}" }
devops-ci: Plan passed with no destroy operations. MR pipeline: success ✅
infra-bot: Policy check failed: "KMS key without rotation policy" in module/gpu-pools v1.4.0 — remediation suggested.
Mia: infra-bot flagged old kms pattern. I updated module to attach rotation schedule and added tests. Pushed new commit.
devops-ci: Re-run pipeline: success. Plan shows kms schedule added only; no resource replacement.
Emily: Once merged, let's do staged rollout: us-east-1 (staging), then us-west-2 (canary), then eu-west-1.
Raj: Cost note: adding gpu capacity will double monthly reserved spend if autoscale floor not configured. Add autoscale_min and autoscale_max defaults.
Mia: Set autoscale_min = 0, autoscale_max = 8 in module defaults, recommend environment override for production.
Oliver: LGTM. Approving MR. :thumbsup:
Sasha: I'll create a brief runbook for the rollout and include rollback steps (module revert + terraform apply -target=module.gpu_pool).
Mia: Thanks all. Merging in 10m unless any objections.
Emily: No objections. Proceed.
Mia: Merged. Will monitor alerts and open a post-rollout thread.
devops-ci: Deploy job triggered: apply/pipeline/9876 — apply completed successfully.
infra-bot: Alert: new resource tag 'service=gpu-inference' detected across 3 clusters.
Mia: Monitoring CloudWatch and Prometheus dashboards. Ping if you see anomalies. :eyes:
